objective: Use the available development CPU and CUDA device to rehearse the exact external handoff from detached clean worktrees. Restore only manifest-declared untracked payloads, verify before execution, then run the exact registered Phase 7 CPU and CUDA protocol once. This may falsify hidden development-tree dependencies but cannot establish independent hardware or Phase 8.
execution_order: Commit this protocol, preparation/collection implementation, and focused tests.
Run and preserve preflight while clean and evidence targets are absent.
Create detached clean ABI and LayerCake worktrees at the exact registered commits.
Prepare by verifying every tracked manifest entry, copying exactly three declared untracked payloads, verifying the manifest, and preserving the clean runtime preflight.
Run the exact 42-test LayerCake package/host suite in the clean worktree.
Run the registered CPU protocol once. Stop and preserve evidence on failure.
Only after CPU passes, run the registered CUDA protocol once. Stop and preserve evidence on failure.
Collect the six registered evidence files immutably.
Hash-lock and preregister a read-only verifier before interpreting fresh performance metrics.
decision_rule: A local rehearsal passes only if clean tracked source bytes remain unchanged, exactly three manifest-declared untracked files restore, release-manifest and runtime preflight verification pass, all 42 LayerCake tests pass, both fresh device results pass every unchanged Phase 7 gate, all 244 fresh CPU/CUDA output and token identities agree, every fresh functional identity matches the sealed run, and a separately preregistered read-only verifier passes hostile mutations. Performance values may vary but may not cross any frozen gate.
stop_rule: Do not rerun a failed device, tune the runtime, change an artifact, or weaken a threshold. Preserve the first failure and close the rehearsal negatively.
claim_boundary: Same development machine and operator only. A pass proves clean-export local reproducibility and absence of undeclared working-tree dependencies for this packet; it does not prove independent hardware, independent operation, Phase 8, release readiness, Phase 2 human preference, or universal ABI superiority.
